speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: I think there is a Point of Order to be raised.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: The Minister of State had earlier said that we have to deal with a range of things – espionage, for example.

speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
text: So, I was just wondering whether Ms Sylvia Lim was suggesting that she was engaged in espionage.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
text: I do not know the answer and I am not accusing the Government.

speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
text: If Minister of State says he cannot answer it, so be it.
